result.title: Client-Aware Security Adaptive Early Exit Vision Transformers for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
result.summary: Federated learning (FL) trains a shared model across data-owning clients without centralizing raw data, but client data difficulty and compute budgets can differ. We study local early-exit Vision Transformer (ViT) inference, where an intermediate classifier may return a prediction before the final Transformer stage. The proposed method replaces one global acceptance threshold with a client-specific base threshold from label entropy and shallow-exit confidence, then adjusts each input using predictive entropy, confidence, top-two class margin, and exit depth. Aggregation uses only clients that updated a parameter. Security-aware routing reaches 88.70% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 32.0% depth saving and 73.7% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with 30\% saving. On matched six-client non-IID CIFAR-100, full-depth accuracy is 72.28% versus 68.20--71.80% for four heterogeneous-FL baselines; robustness-aware routing reaches 70.01% with 32.55% saving.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究异构联邦学习下 ViT 的本地 early exit 推理，用基于标签熵与浅层置信度的客户端专属阈值替代单一全局阈值，并按预测熵、置信度、top-2 类间隔和退出深度逐样本调整，在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet-1K 上报告约 30% 深度节省。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐输入依据熵、置信度与类别间隔决定退出深度的接受准则，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与精度—计算成本权衡提供可核查线索；但该工作面向联邦分类而非多模态 latent 推理，迁移性需读原文判断。
